physics_goals.quote: The resulting neutron skin thickness $R_n-R_p=0.121 \pm 0.026\ {\rm (exp)} \pm 0.024\ {\rm (model)}$~fm is relatively thin yet consistent with many model calculations.
physics_goals.value: Measure the neutral weak form factor and neutron skin of 48Ca with parity-violating electron scattering

summary.plain: CREX is PREX's sister experiment: it measured the neutron skin of calcium-48 with spin-flipped electron beams at Jefferson Lab. The skin turned out relatively thin, a result that must be reconciled with the thick skin of lead.
summary.technical: Calcium Radius Experiment (E12-12-004) in Hall A: parity-violating elastic scattering of longitudinally polarised electrons from 48Ca; A_PV = 2668 ± 106 (stat) ± 40 (syst) ppb, F_W = 0.1304 ± 0.0052 ± 0.0020, neutron skin R_n - R_p = 0.121 ± 0.026 (exp) ± 0.024 (model) fm.
